parse: (: whenever_full_redistribute (Implication (And (Member $x full) (Experiencer $x sk_moon_1)) (And (Member (sk_redistribute $x) redistribute) (Agent (sk_redistribute $x) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_redistribute $x) mire_essence_reserve) (During (sk_redistribute $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a COPULAR trigger clause under 'whenever' ('whenever the moon is full'): the whenever machinery mandates a (During <consequent> <trigger>) tie, which needs an eventuality in the outer slot, but the enumerated state-reification triggers (resultative / connective endpoint / time modifier / adjective's PP complement / focus particle / approximator) do not include a rule premise, so nothing states whether or how the trigger state is reified into the premise
review.notes: The parse resolves the gap by reifying the trigger state as the bound premise variable ((Member $x full) (Experiencer $x sk_moon_1)), which matches the state-witness shape defined elsewhere; sk_moon_1 / sk_council_1 as premise/conclusion constants are licensed because top-level facts assert them. 'the Council' correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default (kind atom, no Name), and the bare-plural non-specific object stays the bare kind filler mire_essence_reserve with its compound genus.
